_readme: Example sources, all DISABLED. Copy the entries you want into config/sources.json and set
"enabled": true. Before enabling anything: read the publisher's terms and robots.txt, confirm
the list is meant to be consumed programmatically, and keep the request volume at one fetch per
source per refresh cycle (the worker does exactly that). Do not add sources that require
bypassing a paywall, CAPTCHA, rate limit or login, and do not scrape sites that forbid it.
url or path, protocol (hint for entries without a scheme), itemsPath (json only),
fields (json field mapping, first listed name wins), maxEntries (hard cap per source),
trust (0-1 source reliability, feeds scoring), note (free text).

sources.note: Public API published for programmatic consumption.
Static file on a public raw-content host.
Plain `host:port` lines; frequently stale, hence the lower trust.
Shape example: point this at an inventory API you own or are explicitly allowed to read.
Offline seed file. Paths resolve against the process CWD and may not traverse outside it.
